# Steam Vault v1.0.0

**Release date:** 2026-10-15
**Version Type:** Semantic Versioning

## ✨ Highlights

Steam Vault v1.0.0 marks the initial production release of the modern cross-platform Steam library organizer and manager built with Tauri v2 and Svelte 5. Serving as a clean-room, cross-platform library organizer and manager, Steam Vault gives users full control over their Steam collections, categories, storage, metadata, and custom artwork without requiring fragile web scraping.

Featuring an obsidian dark glassmorphism design system, high-performance embedded SQLite metadata caching, dynamic smart collections (`filterSpec`), offline game engine and emulator detection, multi-provider metadata enrichment (Steam, VNDB, PCGamingWiki, IGDB, SteamGridDB), and zero-dependency hand-rolled internationalization supporting all 30 official Steam languages.

## 🚀 Key Improvements & Features

- **M5 Dark Glassmorphism Design System** — Unified obsidian frosted glass aesthetic with multi-layer backdrop blur, ambient cyan/slate borders, interactive cards, and responsive custom platform window controls across all 8 views.
- **Embedded SQLite Metadata Cache** — In-process SQLite engine (`rusqlite` bundled in WAL mode) providing sub-millisecond cached metadata lookups with compound indices on `(provider, app_id)`, automated TTL expiration, and zero-touch migration from legacy JSON caches.
- **Dynamic Smart Collections** — Persist named dynamic filter presets (`filter-presets.json`), evaluate library rules against tags/genres/platforms/features, and save native Valve `filterSpec` smart collections directly to `cloud-storage-namespace-1.json`.
- **Hand-Rolled 30-Language Localization Engine** — Hand-crafted reactive i18n engine with parameter interpolation, English fallback safety, RTL layout support for Arabic, and support for all 30 official Steam languages.
- **Multi-Provider Metadata & Engine Sniffer** — Keyless VNDB Kana API integration for visual novels, Steam Store Search for non-Steam games, offline PE VersionInfo and Ren'Py/RPG Maker manifest sniffers, and automated SteamGridDB artwork fetching.
- **External Platform & Emulator Manager** — Scans and auto-imports non-Steam games from GOG, Epic Games, itch.io, Amazon Games, Ubisoft Connect, EA, Battle.net, Xbox Game Pass / Microsoft Store, and 11 emulators (Dolphin, PCSX2, DuckStation, Project64, PPSSPP, RPCS3, Citra, Cemu, Ryujinx, mGBA, Snes9x, RetroArch).
- **Storage & Library Manager** — Inspect mounted disks and Steam library folders, move games or entire libraries between drives, and register/unregister storage paths with safety guards ensuring Steam is closed before file mutations.
- **Custom Artwork Manager** — Inspect, set, download, or remove Steam's 5 custom grid artwork slots (portrait, landscape, hero, logo, icon) in `userdata/<id3>/config/grid/` with automated image format sniffing and backup creation.

## ✅ Changed

- **Platform scanner performance** — Replaced drive letter probing with instantaneous `sysinfo::Disks` mounted volume enumeration and $O(1)$ in-memory emulator extension matching with opt-in all-drive scanning.
- **VDF KeyValues canonicalization** — Canonicalized KeyValues serialization to strictly preserve Valve's quoted `Exe` / `StartDir` syntax and camel-case keys.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Steam metadata batch fetching** — Fixed HTTP 400 errors by bounding concurrency to single app-id lookups.
- **Platform serde casing** — Corrected `Platform` enum serialization to lowercase to synchronize with frontend Svelte TypeScript definitions.
- **Ubuntu 22.04 CI packaging** — Standardized on `libayatana-appindicator3-dev` and WebKitGTK 4.1 for clean Linux binary packaging.

## 🔍 Platform / Compatibility Matrix

- **Windows**: Windows 10 (1809+) & Windows 11 (x64, arm64). Built as `.msi` (WiX) and `.exe` (NSIS).
- **macOS**: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later. Built as universal binary `.dmg` (Apple Silicon `aarch64` & Intel `x86_64`).
- **Linux**: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 38+, Arch Linux, and standard systemd/glibc distributions with WebKitGTK 4.1. Built as `.deb` and `.AppImage`.
- **Mobile (Android / iOS)**: Explicitly unsupported (Valve Steam mobile clients do not manage local game installations).

## 🛠️ Build, Installation & Verification

### Local Build & Run

```bash
npm ci
npm run build
npx tauri build
```

### Verification Results
- **Rust unit tests**: `cargo test` passed 21 unit tests (0 failures).
- **Code quality & formatting**: `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets` passed with 0 errors/warnings.
- **Frontend verification**: `svelte-check` and `vite build` completed cleanly with 0 TypeScript/build errors.
- **Localization test suite**: `node scripts/test-i18n.mjs` verified all 30 language dictionaries complete.
- **Overall test runner**: `node scripts/test.mjs all` passed across all 7 suites.
